sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A globose to flattened cactus of the Chihuahuan Desert, the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. Its ribbed stems are usually 10–15 cm across and bear strong spines.

sections.title: Flowering
sections.text: Pink flowers appear at the stem tip and are about 4–7 cm long. Slow growth and a limited range make the plant vulnerable to collection.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is established in the references consulted.
